plan.notes: Official UNK catalog sample 4-year plan for the Psychology BS (Department of Psychology). Semester subtotals (15/15/16/15/15/14/15/15) and the 120 total match the published plan exactly. Blank cells in the published grid are recorded as labeled General Education/minor/elective choice slots. The BS requires two science courses (6+ hours) beyond the General Education Natural Science requirement, chosen with an advisor from BIOL, CHEM, CYBR, GEOG, MATH 115+, or PHYS. A minor or second major is required; a minimum C is required in all major courses; at least 50% of Psychology courses must be taken at UNK. This is a sample plan; actual course selection and sequence may vary and should be discussed with an academic advisor.
